test_title: PYST 11: SSC CHSL 2023 - English (Held On: 04 Aug, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
**Direction: Identify the INCORRECTLY spelt word in the following sentence.**

Staying healthy and exercising daily enhances an athelet’s ability.
solution: Here, the incorrectly spelt word is **"athelet's."** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The incorrect spelling in the sentence is** "athelet's."** • The correct spelling is** "athlete's."** • The error is in the placement of the **"e"** and **"t" **in the word. • The correct spelling maintains the** "e"** before the **"t."** • **"Athlete" **means a person who can run, jump, etc. very well, especially one who takes part in sports competitions, etc. (खेल-कूद प्रतियोगिताओं में भाग लेने वाला व्‍यक्ति) • **Example**: *He became a professional **athlete**__.* • The correct answer is option 1. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • **Option 2, "healthy": **not often ill; strong and well. (निरोग, ठीक-ठाक; सशक्त और स्‍वस्‍थ) • **Option 3, "exercising": **to do some form of physical activity in order to stay fit and healthy. (शारीरिक व्‍यायाम करना) • **Option 4, "enhances": **to improve something or to make something look better. (बेहतर दिखने के लिए, किसी वस्‍तु में सुधार लाना) 38:T108a, The correct answer is** "Did the thief steal the painting?"**
